findings.governingReading: it was a humble or inadequate meal
findings.explanation: Sakura’s conventional self-effacing response to praise becomes a neutral welcome.

findings.highlight: you both ate everything in your bowls
findings.evidenceJa: きれいに食べてくれましたね
findings.governingReading: they ate the meal cleanly and completely
findings.explanation: The English supplies bowls as the praised object and removes Sakura’s clean-eating phrasing.

findings.evidenceJa: 土鍋と三人分のどんぶり
findings.governingReading: an earthenware pot and bowls for three
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the hot pot from the table inventory.
The food-specific array of garnishes becomes unspecified condiments.
A measured reason Shirou can work becomes a general subjective recovery claim.

findings.highlight: take the dishes to the kitchen
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds the kitchen as the destination Sakura explicitly assigns.

findings.evidenceJa: テーブル周りの後片付け
findings.governingReading: clear and tidy the area around the table
findings.explanation: The broader dining-area cleanup is narrowed to the tabletop.
The English prematurely decides the complexion is pallor.

findings.governingReading: does his face look blue or pale
findings.explanation: Shirou asks about color; mirror moon makes him ask how severe his appearance is.

findings.evidenceJa: 青いと言うのではなく、悪いのです
findings.governingReading: Saber corrects him: not blue, but unhealthy or bad
findings.explanation: mirror moon reverses Saber’s explicit distinction and calls him pale again.

findings.highlight: magical energy, the lifeline for a magus
findings.evidenceJa: マスター[line3]魔術師にとって生命線とも言える魔力
findings.governingReading: magical energy, a lifeline for a Master—that is, a magus
findings.explanation: The English removes the Master role from Saber’s explanation.

findings.highlight: I noticed no problems during the battle last night
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜の戦闘ではシロウに負担をかけた覚えはありません
findings.governingReading: Saber does not remember placing any burden on Shirou in the previous night’s battle
findings.explanation: Saber’s accounting of her own mana burden becomes a generic observation that there were no problems.

findings.highlight: that temple might have been set up to drain magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: あの境内そのものに魔力を吸い上げる仕掛け
findings.governingReading: the temple precinct itself may have contained a mechanism that siphons magical energy
findings.explanation: The exact grounds and embedded mechanism become the temple as a whole being “set up.”

findings.evidenceJa: 当事者である貴方がそう言うのなら
findings.governingReading: if Shirou, the person directly affected, says so
findings.explanation: Saber’s reason for deferring to Shirou’s bodily report disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分のコトを蔑ろにしている
findings.governingReading: neglect or disregard his own well-being
findings.explanation: The English weakens Saber’s charge that Shirou treats himself as expendable.

findings.evidenceJa: 朝に続いて感謝します
findings.governingReading: Saber thanks Sakura again following the morning meal
findings.explanation: The English omits the continuity of Saber appreciating both meals.

findings.highlight: Senpai’s the best when it comes to rice porridge and udon
findings.evidenceJa: お粥とおうどんは、先輩の独壇場
findings.governingReading: porridge and udon are Shirou’s exclusive domain or specialty
findings.explanation: “The best” preserves praise but loses Sakura’s theatrical 独壇場 idiom.
mirror moon adds reciprocal assistance to the simple fact of joint work.

findings.highlight: It’s a good time to take a break
findings.evidenceJa: 昼休みとしてはちょうどいい時間
findings.governingReading: it is just the right time for a lunch break
findings.explanation: The English removes the school-day lunch-hour frame from the near-one-o’clock observation.
